info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to view available guest passes for fitness memberships. It serves as a valuable resource for potential clients and fitness centers looking to offer flexible access options. By querying this endpoint, businesses can provide insights into guest pass availability and conditions. Typical consumers of this API are fitness center administrators, marketing teams, and prospective gym members exploring membership options.
